title: VHS camcorder signal chain
description: Make a frame look like it was shot on a consumer camcorder and recorded to VHS, using the real signal numbers (docs/RESEARCH.md section 2): ~320 luma samples per line, ~40 chroma samples per line, chroma delayed to the right, edge-enhancement ringing, tape noise, snow, dropouts, line jitter, a head-switching band at the bottom and CCD smear.

clauses.text: Colour is far blurrier than brightness, about one eighth of the detail, so colour bleeds past edges while black-and-white edges stay fairly sharp.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "chroma is eight times softer than luma" passes

clauses.text: Colour sits a couple of pixels to the right of the brightness, and brightness edges get the camcorder sharpening halo.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "chroma is delayed to the right" and "sharpening overshoots edges" pass

clauses.text: The bottom few lines carry the head-switching band, shoved sideways, while the rest of the picture is not; bright lights smear into a vertical column like a CCD.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "head switching band sits at the bottom" and "ccd smears bright points vertically" pass

clauses.text: Noise, snow and jitter move from frame to frame, but the same seed and frame number always give the same picture, and tiny frames never crash.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "tape noise is animated but reproducible" and "tiny frames are safe" pass

cases.description: with noise off, a colour edge spreads over at least 12 px (8-px chroma samples plus smoothing; a 5-px divisor fails) while a grey edge's 10-90% rise is at most 3 px
the chroma edge midpoint sits 1-3 px right of the luma edge midpoint
a dark-to-light step overshoots above the plateau and undershoots below the floor
only the bottom band rows differ from the band-off render
a single clipped point brightens its whole column, not its neighbours
frame 1 differs from frame 2 with only tape noise enabled (jitter and head switching off, so they cannot mask frozen noise); frame 1 twice is identical
0x0, 1x1, 2x9 and 9x2 frames with every artifact on
